description: Input: the same fields as quote_ugc, plus attempt. Start a lip-synced UGC video; the actor is actor_id, image or the default. Format and resolution follow the request and the source, defaulting to 1080x1920. Captions are OPT-IN: ask the user first. A field marked NOT HONORED YET does not reach the renderer. Poll get_run with its poll.arguments; a failed run whose video is still being made can return to queued, named in warnings[]. attempt=2,3,… starts a NEW run. A video like a reference reel: plan_reference_remake with its analysis_id instead. Price: HeyGen presenter: presenter, HeyGen Avatar IV 9 credits per second the presenter is in the video, covered or not; OmniHuman presenter: presenter, OmniHuman 2.0 22 credits per second the presenter is in the video, covered or not; each plus production (voice and render) 1 credits per second of video plus live avatar on a call 400 credits per call still in the video, at least 50. Quote first with quote_ugc.
name: make_ugc
title: Make a talking-actor video
